request.query: Founder-led B2B software company selling directly without a sales team. Return exactly 2 distinct companies.
request.systemPrompt: Give a working website domain for every company. Never repeat a company.

output.text: Two distinct founder-led B2B software companies matching the direct, no-dedicated-sales-team criterion are provided, with working domains and available company metrics. Revenue and workforce figures are sourced disclosures or estimates and may vary by reporting date.

companies.name: Chatbase
companies.description: Founder-led B2B software company providing a self-serve platform for businesses to build and deploy customer-facing AI agents. It is bootstrapped and explicitly operated without a dedicated sales team, using product-led growth alongside self-serve purchasing.

companies.name: Oh Dear
companies.description: Founder-led B2B website-monitoring software company covering uptime, SSL, broken links, DNS, SEO, accessibility, and server health. The two founders sell through a self-serve free-trial model, building in public and relying on word of mouth rather than a sales team.
